scope: The quay net-mending rack, Vliet drying rack and their reusable model variants. This does not constitute whole-city environment acceptance.

construction.net: Geometric diamond mesh, flattened crossing knots, bowed panels, hem ropes and header ties replace stretched alpha cards. Ground net has five folds instead of an opaque mound.
construction.props: Beveled posts and sign board, turned stool seats, splayed legs and a woven basket with rounded rim. Removed one duplicate visible crossbar from the drying rack.

edge_exceptions: Hidden mating ends of cords and wooden joints remain flat; exposed edges and silhouettes are rounded.
Unrelated triangles in the merged quay-furniture surface retain their original arrays, including pre-existing degeneracies; these were not newly generated.

materials.name: trades
materials.use: Existing photographic sign substrate and authored wording, mapped on both board faces.

materials.name: hemp and wicker
materials.use: Dark hemp cord and warmer basket reeds use the existing native weather/fog shader. No alpha atlas or new raster assets.

collision.mender_structure: Exact original coarse obstacle triangle positions retained. All new visual surfaces excluded from collision.
collision.vliet: 48 curtain triangles follow the repaired hem; 44 original header triangles retained. Fine cords and knots never enter physics.
collision.merged_quay_furniture: Exact original obstacle triangle positions retained. Only 32 old visible post/header triangles were replaced; 7136 unrelated visible triangles remain.

preservation: Original node transforms, placements, IDs and metadata retained. Repacked quay root passed 151 scene/property/mesh preservation checks. Reusable prototypes were also repaired so new placements use the corrected assets.
navigation: The thinner drying curtain opens seven quarter-metre cells at its edge (0.4375 square metres); it closes no cells. A local fixture with the original support frame reproduces the entire live-map free-cell increase. Other collision faces remain identical. The map digest therefore changes deliberately; it is not reported as unchanged.
startup: All geometry is authored offline and saved as resources. Existing content-hash cache invalidation covers the changed assets; no new construction runs before play. General startup optimization remains paused at Steve's request.
remaining: The permanent net-mender character snapshots retain their older faces, garments and poses; the rear/top views also show overlapping figures needing a separate character-placement review.
Other market timber, carts and barrel variants remain in the broader visual audit backlog.
Adjacent building drainage and the entire quay are not certified complete by this local rack repair.
